CALABASAS, Calif., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: NTHI) (“NeOnc” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for central nervous system (CNS) cancers, today announced that data from its intranasal NEO100 and oral NEO212 programs will be presented in two posters on Friday, November 13, at the 31st Annual Meeting and Education Day of the Society for Neuro-Oncology (SNO), held November 12 to 15, 2026, at the Pennsylvania Convention Center in Philadelphia.


“We look forward to presenting data from both of our clinical programs at SNO,” said Amir F. Heshmatpour, Executive Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of NeOnc. “These presentations reflect the progress we are making in bringing new approaches to patients with brain cancer.”


**Presentation Details**


**Title:** Durable Radiographic Remission and Prolonged Survival with Intranasal NEO100 in Recurrent WHO Grade III/IV IDH1-Mutant Astrocytoma: Updated Results from a Phase 1/2a Study and Compassionate Use Experience
**Abstract Number:** CTNI-26
**Presentation Type:** Poster
**Session:** Poster Session
**Presenter:** Thomas C. Chen, MD, PhD, University of Southern California and NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc.
**Date and Time:** Friday, November 13, 2026, 7:30 to 9:30 p.m. EST
**Location:** Exhibit Halls D and E, Second Floor, Pennsylvania Convention Center, Philadelphia


**Title:** Oral NEO212 in TMZ-Resistant Recurrent GBM and Brain Metastases: Phase 1 Safety, PK, and Early Signals of Activity
**Abstract Number:** CTNI-27
**Presentation Type:** Poster
**Session:** Poster Session
**Presenter:** Josh Neman, PhD, University of Southern California and NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc.
**Date and Time:** Friday, November 13, 2026, 7:30 to 9:30 p.m. EST


**About NEO100**


NEO100 is a highly purified form of perillyl alcohol administered intranasally. Its delivery approach is designed to provide a non-invasive route to the brain. NEO100 remains investigational, and its safety and efficacy have not been established.


**About NEO212**


NEO212 is an investigational oral conjugate of temozolomide and NEO100. It is being studied for CNS cancers, including recurrent glioblastoma. Preclinical studies support further evaluation of its potential activity and delivery characteristics; clinical efficacy and safety have not been established. NEO212 is being developed under an FDA investigational new drug application.


**About NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc.**


NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for central nervous system cancers. Its investigational programs include intranasal NEO100 and oral NEO212. NEO212 has completed Phase 1 dose escalation and is advancing toward Phase 2 development. NeOnc exclusively licenses a worldwide portfolio of issued patents and pending applications from the University of Southern California related to NEO100, NEO212 and other drug candidates and delivery approaches.
